stem: Two cultivation beds have the same programmed irrigation volume, but one shows slower dryback and consistently higher runoff EC. Which evidence set best tests whether their root-zone behavior is actually different?
choices: Delivered volume, drainage/runoff, moisture trend, root-zone pH and EC, root observations and a matched comparison over time.
The fertilizer product name and label color.
One room-temperature reading taken after irrigation.
rationale: Programmed inputs do not prove equivalent root-zone conditions. Comparing delivered water, drainage, moisture dynamics, chemistry and root observations over time provides evidence about whether the two beds are behaving differently.
